★Request
Display Epiphaneia (Summer Jersey)

■Stage Direction
A test (Voice sample available)

I see! But you understand how amazing the Voice of Destiny is now, right?!
Whenever that Voice pushes me forward, only good things happen!

All right!
Leave it to me!

How will that star shine, and what will it achieve?
I don't know just yet. But the path its light guides us along... is undoubtedly the right one.

Of course!
Because I'm—

It's been like that ever since I can remember!
Whenever I followed where the Voice of Destiny told me to go, something good always happened.
...Huh?

Now, listen to my voice!
Until the day the world is filled with destiny—you'll stick with me, won't you?!

In that instant. The very moment she said those words—the clouds parted,
and a sky filled with countless stars appeared, completely overwhelming our field of view.

Epiphaneia will surely... no, she will definitely achieve something great.
I don't know what that might be yet. But—my heart is already pounding with excitement.

Ahaha, so it really is better if you can hear it, right?!
Whenever this Voice says it's good, it always leads to the right outcome!
—A shift.

A test... That Trainer will test themselves.
If they fall short... they will no longer be your Trainer.

In our previous matchup, she ran completely as she pleased without pacing herself at all,
which left her with nothing at the end and resulted in a crushing defeat.
And so, after being dragged around all over the place—

...Indeed, wherever the Voice of Destiny guided us, we were blessed with all sorts of good fortune.
I just hadn't had the composure to appreciate it, but the results—were entirely positive.

We can't control the Voice of Destiny. In that case—if I shout loud enough to overpower
that Voice of Destiny... perhaps we can conquer the "Voice."

Epiphaneia's faith in the Voice of Destiny is as unshakeable as ever. In that case...
it might be easier to guide her if I try to understand the true nature of that voice.

Even so—we were defeated.
Symboli Kris S's strength was truly on another dimension...

Yeah! To you, who wanted to hear the Voice of Destiny—
to you, who became the first step toward my dream, I'll give you a sky full of stars.

Whoa, whoa, whoa! That's the first time anyone's ever told me that!
I like it, that's awesome! All right, let's do this! Follow me!

Epiphaneia's abilities are already at the peak of what can be polished right now.
If there's any chance of winning—it lies in catching her breath and making the right move at the right time.

—! ...I see, then—let's go together!
WOOOOOAAAAAAHHHHH...!!!!
I won't!!

Trainer, I'll lead you to the greatest outcome!
So don't hesitate anymore! Just believe in me!

And yet—no one else can hear it.
Don't you think that's such a waste?

Sorry, sorry! But the Voice of Destiny told me to go faster!
Thanks to that, I reached incredible speeds, right? Wasn't it amazing?!

For Epiphaneia to beat Symboli Kris S—
the very first skill she needs to acquire is "holding back during the run."

If what Epiphaneia hears isn't the Voice of Destiny—
but my own voice. Then I can stand tall as her Trainer.

Now, listen to my voice!
Until the day the world is filled with destiny—you'll stick with me, won't you?!

...Huh?
...Voice, not yet? Is it still not...—

Once my dream comes true, you'll see a world even more glittering than this.
—I'll fill your eyes with it, just you wait!

How many times has this happened now? Epiphaneia completely losing control
and running wild... I'm honestly starting to resent this Voice of Destiny.

Whether you change or not.
Whether you get left behind... is up to you.

Never doubting herself, Epiphaneia firmly believes in a shining future.
Perhaps influenced by her—a conviction began to take root within me as well.
I knew it, you really are—my destiny...!

Interesting!
—Let's try it!

...Are you really sure about that, though?
No hard feelings, but once I hear the Voice of Destiny—I won't be stopping.

Yeah! If everyone feels my "destiny," they'll hear the Voice too.
Everyone will get a push on the back from that Voice! —Well, isn't that amazing?!

I thought there could only ever be one voice. But...
I was wrong. Your voice was pushing me forward too...

...Hey, are you telling me you don't want to hear the Voice of Destiny?
Why not?

You were defeated. But—you brought about change.
Go—... Deliver results.

Ooh... I knew taking that path was the right choice!
Trainer, take a look too! —Lift your head up!

—See? Isn't it a great view!
You can see sooooo far away... It's breathtaking!
LET'S GOOOOOOOOOOOO!!!!

—It says, "Celebrating 1 Million Users: Free Extra-Large Sticker Pack"!
That worked out great, and you look super cute in the photo too!

Oh! The weather cleared up just like I thought!
—Trainer, this is a present from me. Take it!

Ah! You heard it just now, right, Trainer?!
Let's take a picture, dive into the photo booth!

—While I was able to get to know Epiphaneia even better, in the end...
I never heard the Voice of Destiny. There's no time left to prepare before the race...

—It overlapped perfectly with the Voice of Destiny.
Your voice, shouting, "Now's the time!"...!

Epiphaneia breaks out cleanly into the race. Since she hasn't
heard the Voice of Destiny yet... she's running in great form.

At that moment, all clouds of doubt cleared away. In my heart, there was only one thing...
shining brightly like a star—my desire to witness Epiphaneia's future—

*pant*... *gasp*...!
I'm so beat!!

Epiphaneia finished the run without losing control. When it came time to make a move,
she responded perfectly...—My voice reached her.
Because I'm loved by destiny!
—You're going to shout, Trainer?
After that—everything developed in a flash.

—Oh, it's getting cloudy... but it'll be fine. ...So, how was it!
You heard it too, didn't you? The Voice of Destiny!

—Nah, this animal trail looks way better!
The Voice of Destiny says so too!! UOOOOOHH!!

Wait, Kris S?! So you were the one waiting for me!
And—
